raw_response:
The company exhibits extremely high leverage with a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 9.02 and total liabilities at 90% of total assets, indicating severe solvency risk. Despite strong liquidity (current ratio of 12.41) and a high EBIT margin of 43.67%, the low absolute EBIT ($3,188M) relative to total liabilities ($444,085M) results in a very low EBIT-to-liabilities ratio of 0.72%, suggesting inadequate coverage for debt servicing. Additionally, low asset turnover (1.48%) and poor return on assets (0.65%) further highlight operational inefficiency and high credit risk, placing the issuer in the speculative grade.

DECISION: B
